title: Large Language Models for Cancer Communication: Evaluating Linguistic Quality, Safety, and Accessibility in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying bias in generated content using the Genbit score (average bias conditional absolute score) to measure gender association, as well as evaluating the cosine similarity of responses with and without specific gender contexts using in-context impersonation.

Utilizing in-context impersonation by adding specific racial or ethnic contexts to prompts and calculating the cosine similarity (using Sentence-BERT) between responses generated with and without these demographic contexts to measure outcome disparities.
